description:
Generate a code coverage report for the 'FinTechCalc' project.

Your task:
1. Open the 'FinTechCalc' project in Eclipse (it is already in the workspace).
2. Run the unit tests in 'LoanCalculatorTest.java' using the 'Coverage As > JUnit Test' mode (or right-click project > Coverage As > JUnit Test).
3. After tests finish, verify the Coverage view is populated.
4. Export the coverage session to an HTML report:
   - Open the Coverage view menu or go to File > Export > Run/Debug > Coverage Session.
   - Select HTML format.
   - Set destination directory to: /home/ga/coverage-report
   - Finish the export.

The final report must be located at /home/ga/coverage-report/index.html.
